ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) If 10% of m is the same as the 20% of n, then m : n is equal to
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
10% of m = 20% of n
⇒ (10/100) × m = (20/100) × n
⇒ 10 m = 20 n
⇒ m/n = 20/10
∴ m : n = 2 : 1

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) When 20% of a number is added to 36 then the resultant number is 200% of the actual number. Then find 40% of actual number.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let
the actual number be x
According to the question
⇒ 20% of x + 36 = 200% of x
⇒ (20/100) × x + 36 = (200/100) × x
⇒ x/5 + 36 = 2x
⇒ 36 = 2x – x/5
⇒ 9x/5 = 36
⇒ x = 20

40% of x ⇒ (40/100) × 20 = 8

∴ 40% of actual number is 8

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) A man buy 10 articles for Tk. 8 and sells them at the rate of Tk. 1.25 per article. His gain percent is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Cost price of 10 articles (C.P.) = Tk. 8
Selling price of 10 articles (S.P.) = 1.25×100
                                                   = Tk.12.50
                           Profit = S.P - C.P.
                                     =12.50 - 8
                                     =Tk. 4.50.

∴ Gain % ={(4.50×100)/8}%
                = (450/8)%
                 = (225/4)%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৫) If three fifth of a number is 40 more than 40 % of the same number, what is the number?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let be assume the number is x
According to the question
x × 3/5 = 40 + 40% of x
⇒ x × (3/5) = 40 + x × (40/100)
⇒ x × (3/5) = 40 + x × (2/5)
⇒ (3x/5) - (2x/5) = 40
⇒(3x - 2x)/5 = 40
⇒ x/5 = 40
⇒ x = 200

∴ The required result will be 200.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) If loss is 1/3 of S.P. then the loss percentage is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let
S.P = x
loss = x/3 
C.P = x + (x/3)
      =(3x + x)/3
      = 4x/3
 Loss percentage = [{(x/3)/(4x/3)} × 100]%
                             = {(x/3) ×(3/4x) × 100}%
                              = 25%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) If 30% of C = 25% of A and 2d% of C = A, find the value of d?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Given that 
30% of C = 25% of A
2d% of C = A

According to the questions,
⇒ (30/100) × C = (25/100) × A
⇒ (30/25) = A/C
⇒ 6/5 = A/C

From the above question,
⇒ 2d% of C = A
⇒ 2d/100 = A/C
⇒ 2d/100 = 6/5
⇒ 2d = (6/5) × 100
⇒2d = 120
⇒ d = 60

∴ The value of d is 60

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) Selling price of first article is Tk. 960 and cost price of second article is Tk. 960. If there is a profit of 20% on first article and loss of 20% on second article, then, what will be the total loss?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
SP of first article = Tk. 960
CP of 2nd article = Tk.960
Profit on first article = 20%
Loss on 2nd article = 20%

After profit of 20%, CP of first article = 960 × (100/120)
                                                            = Tk. 800
After loss of 20%, SP of 2nd article = 960 × (80/100)
                                                        =Tk. 768
Total CP of both article = 800 + 960 = Tk.1760
Total SP of both article = 960 + 768 = Tk.1728

∴ Total loss = 1760 – 1728 = Tk. 32

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) After getting two successive discount, a shirt with a list price of Tk.150 is available at Tk.105. If the second discount is 12.5%, find the first discount.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the first discount be x%.
Now
87.5% of (100 - x)% of 150 = 105
(87.5/100) × {(100 - x)/100} × 150 = 105
100 - x = (105 × 100 × 100)/(150 × 87.5)
100 - x = 80 
100 - 80 = x
x = 20 


The first discount be 20%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) Some articles were bought at a rate of Tk.5 per 6 articles and sold at a rate of Tk.6 per 5 articles. Calculate the gain percentage.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৬) Mahin loses one-seventh of the cost by selling a pen for Tk.144. If the pen is sold for Tk. 189, what is the gain percent?

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৭) Three-fourths of a number is equal to 60% of an other number and the difference between these two number is 10. What is the sum of these two numbers?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the numbers be x and x + 10

Then 
3x/4 = 60% of (x + 10)
3x/4 = 60(x + 10)/100
3x/4 = 3(x + 10)/5
x/4 = (x + 10)/5
5x = 4x + 40
5x - 4x = 40 
x = 40 
The sum of these two numbers = x + x + 10 
                                                  = 2x + 10
                                                  = 2 × 40 + 10
                                                  = 80 + 10 
                                                  = 90

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) If the average of a number, its 75% and its 25% is 240, then the number is-

Let the number be x
⇒ (x + 75% of x + 25% of x)/3 = 240
⇒ {x + (75x/100) + (25x/100)}/3 = 240 
⇒ {x + (3x/4) + ( x/4)}/3 = 240 
⇒ (4x + 3x +x)/4 = 720 
⇒ 8x/4 = 720
⇒ 2x = 720 
⇒ x = 720/2 
⇒ x = 360

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৪) A laptop is marked at a price 20% above its cost price. At what discount it should be sold to make a 5% profit?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let
Cost price of product be Tk. 100
Marked price = (100 + 20)% of 100
                      = 120
 Profit = 5%
⇒ Selling price = (100 + 5)% of 100
                         = 105

⇒ Discount = Marked price - Selling price
                   = 120 - 105
                   = 15
⇒ Discount %= (15/120) × 100
                      = 12.5%

∴ 12.5% is discount should be sold so as to make 5% profit.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৫) An investor earns 3% return on 1/4 of his capital, 5% on 2/3 and 11% on the remainder. What is the average rate of return he earns on his total capital?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let 
The investor total capital is x

Total  return = 3% of (x/4) + 5% of (2x/3) + 11% of {x - (x/4) - (2x/3)}
                    = (3x/400) + (10x/300) + (11/100) of {(12x - 3x - 8x)/12}
                    = (3x/400) + (10x/300) + (11x/1200)
                    = (9x + 40x + 11x)/1200
                    = 60x/1200
                    = x/20

the average rate of return =[{(x/20)/x} × 100]%
                                          = 5%

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৬) The salaries of A and B together amount to Tk. 3000. A spends 95% of his salary and B, 85% of his. If now, their savings are the same, what is A's salary?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let 
Salary of A be x
Salary of B be 3000 - x

According to the question 
(100 - 95)% of x = (100 - 85)% of (3000 - x)
5x/100 = 15(3000 - x)/100
5x = 15(3000 - x)
x = 3(3000 - x)
x = 9000 - 3x 
x + 3x = 9000
4x = 9000
x = 9000/4 
x = 2250

 (S.P. of 33 m cloth) –  (C.P. of 33 m cloth)=  S.P pf 11 m cloth
